Package com.microservices.reservation.warehouse.controllers

Class ReservationController

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.reservation.warehouse.controllers.ReservationController
@RestController @RequestMapping("api/v1/reservation") public class ReservationController extends Object
This controller handles HTTP requests related to reservations. It provides endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, and processing reservations within the warehouse reservation system.

The controller uses ReservationServiceManagement to process the business logic and MessageMapper to convert service responses into API responses.

Version:
1.0
Author:
